2026-07-30.content:
Support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint enablement using the
Service Usage v2beta API is shut down.

For more information, see
[Feature deprecations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/service-usage/docs/deprecations).

summary.title: MCP endpoint enablement API deprecated
summary.summary: Support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint enablement through the Service Usage v2beta API has been shut down. For more details, please refer to the Feature deprecations page.

2026-07-24.content:
As of July 30, 2026, support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
enablement and consumer policies using the Service Usage v2beta API will be shut
down.

For more information, see
[Feature deprecations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/service-usage/docs/deprecations).

summary.title: MCP policy management via Service Usage v2beta API deprecated
summary.summary: Support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enablement and consumer policies using the Service Usage v2beta API will be shut down on July 30, 2026. This change affects how you manage MCP policies. For more details, please refer to the feature deprecations documentation.

2025-11-11.content:
Service Usage support for
[hierarchical service activation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/service-usage/docs/hierarchical-service-activation/overview)
is available in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).
This feature lets you enable and disable services across your organization's
resource hierarchy.

summary.title: Hierarchical Service Activation Available in Preview
summary.summary: Service Usage now supports hierarchical service activation in Preview, allowing you to enable and disable services across your organization's resource hierarchy.
